sentences.japanese: 君はお父さんの生まれ故郷を訪ねたことがありますか。
sentences.english: Have you visited the town where your father was born?

sentences.japanese: 君はお父さんが働いている会社を訪れたことがあるかい。
sentences.english: Have you ever visited the office where your father works?

sentences.japanese: 君がその美術館を訪ねたのはいつだったのか。
sentences.english: When was it that you visited the museum?

sentences.japanese: 近頃は私を訪ねるひともほとんどいない。
sentences.english: Few people visit me these days.

sentences.japanese: 近いうちに春が当地に訪れるだろう。
sentences.english: Spring will be here before long.
